description: Freshman-year scholarship for NC public high school seniors, judged on character, community involvement, and scholastic achievement.
eligibility_text: North Carolina resident; public high school senior planning to continue their education; official transcript with a cumulative unweighted GPA of at least 2.5; all materials due electronically by the first Monday in February.
notes: Seeded 2026-09-26 by Claude through the Add Award prefill path (Catalog Integrity Task 2.2). Not verified: open the source page before setting trust to verified_local. Prefill missed: deadline ('first Monday in February' is a rule, not a date); letters; essay prompts. The page does not state the amount.
renewal_terms: Paid for the fall and spring of freshman year only.

essay_prompts: How the philosophies and ideals of Dr. King influence your life (1 page or less).
Why you deserve this scholarship and your need for financial assistance (1 page or less).

sponsor: North Carolina Association of Educators / NC Foundation for Public School Children
title: NCAE Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Scholarship
